principle: Interventions change PISA-aligned indicator z-scores first; affected vector composites are then recalculated and mapped back to the fixed Korean baseline percentile distribution.

laptop_internet_package.label: Laptop + reliable home internet
laptop_internet_package.evidence_level: High for the direct access change; no automatic claim about achievement, agency, support, or wellbeing
laptop_internet_package.direct_vector_claim: Directly improves the ICTHOME component of digital access.
laptop_internet_package.method_explanation: The package closes a quality- and dosage-adjusted share of the student's gap to the 90th percentile of Korea's observed ICTHOME distribution. The full digital-access vector is then recalculated using ICTHOME, ICTQUAL, and ICTENQ.
assumptions: The device is usable for schoolwork and reliable internet is actually available.
The intervention directly changes access, not learning achievement.
No spillover into agency or wellbeing is added without separate causal evidence.
warnings: A laptop without curriculum integration, suitable software, or guidance may not improve learning outcomes.
laptop_internet_package.time_note: Time is modelled with G(t)=1-2^(-t/3), so 3 months is the transparent half-time for implementation/adoption of the modelled endpoint. This is a scenario parameter, not a claim that individual development follows a universal law.

school_ict_upgrade.label: School ICT quality upgrade
school_ict_upgrade.evidence_level: High for the direct infrastructure change; no automatic learning-outcome claim
school_ict_upgrade.direct_vector_claim: Directly improves the ICTQUAL component of digital access.
school_ict_upgrade.method_explanation: The upgrade closes a quality- and dosage-adjusted share of the gap to the 80th percentile of Korea's observed ICTQUAL distribution.
assumptions: Hardware, connectivity, maintenance, and student availability are all included in the programme.
The target is a programme-design benchmark rather than an estimated causal treatment effect.
warnings: Better infrastructure does not guarantee meaningful use. ICTENQ remains unchanged unless a separate instructional intervention is selected.
school_ict_upgrade.time_note: Time is modelled with G(t)=1-2^(-t/6), so 6 months is the transparent half-time for implementation/adoption of the modelled endpoint. This is a scenario parameter, not a claim that individual development follows a universal law.

school_resource_upgrade.label: School learning-resource upgrade
school_resource_upgrade.evidence_level: High for the direct reduction in reported shortages; outcome effects are not inferred
school_resource_upgrade.direct_vector_claim: Improves the reverse-scored EDUSHORT component of resources.
school_resource_upgrade.method_explanation: The programme closes a quality- and dosage-adjusted share of the gap to the 75th percentile of Korea's favourable, reverse-scored EDUSHORT distribution.
assumptions: The programme directly addresses the shortages measured by the PISA school index.
Home resources remain unchanged.
warnings: Because EDUSHORT is reported at school level, all students in the same school would normally share this direct change.
school_resource_upgrade.time_note: Time is modelled with G(t)=1-2^(-t/9), so 9 months is the transparent half-time for implementation/adoption of the modelled endpoint. This is a scenario parameter, not a claim that individual development follows a universal law.

growth_mindset_workshop.label: Brief growth-mindset workshop
growth_mindset_workshop.evidence_level: Moderate: large randomized US study on mindset beliefs; transportability to Korea is uncertain
growth_mindset_workshop.direct_vector_claim: Shifts the GROSAGR component of learning agency, not the entire agency vector by a fixed number of percentile points.
growth_mindset_workshop.method_explanation: The central scenario applies the 0.33 SD change in mindset beliefs reported in the National Study of Learning Mindsets. Conservative and optimistic values are transparent sensitivity scenarios, not confidence limits.
assumptions: The workshop is delivered with content and fidelity similar to the evaluated intervention.
The source effect on mindset beliefs can be approximately expressed on the PISA GROSAGR z-score scale.
Quality and dosage scale the indicator shift linearly between zero and the selected scenario.
warnings: The source study was conducted in the United States, not South Korea.
The intervention affected lower-achieving students' grades more than other students, but this phase does not use achievement to individualize the vector effect.
growth_mindset_workshop.time_note: Time is modelled with G(t)=1-2^(-t/4), so 4 months is the transparent half-time for implementation/adoption of the modelled endpoint. This is a scenario parameter, not a claim that individual development follows a universal law.

whole_school_belonging_program.label: Whole-school belonging programme
whole_school_belonging_program.evidence_level: Moderate-low: meta-analytic evidence supports small average social-emotional improvements, with substantial programme heterogeneity
whole_school_belonging_program.direct_vector_claim: Shifts the BELONG component of wellbeing.
whole_school_belonging_program.method_explanation: The central 0.22 SD scenario uses the pooled social-emotional adjustment effect from a meta-analysis of whole-school interventions. The lower and upper values are sensitivity scenarios, not sampling confidence limits.
assumptions: The programme changes school climate, relationships, and practices rather than only giving a one-off motivational talk.
The general social-emotional effect is used as an approximate shift on PISA school belonging.
warnings: Belonging interventions vary widely; a generic label cannot guarantee the central effect.
Life satisfaction and mathematics anxiety are not automatically changed.
whole_school_belonging_program.time_note: Time is modelled with G(t)=1-2^(-t/8), so 8 months is the transparent half-time for implementation/adoption of the modelled endpoint. This is a scenario parameter, not a claim that individual development follows a universal law.

structured_tutoring.label: Structured small-group tutoring
structured_tutoring.evidence_level: High for average learning outcomes; low for mapping tutoring onto PISA TEACHSUP as a human-support proxy
structured_tutoring.direct_vector_claim: Uses TEACHSUP only as an explicit proxy for additional instructional adult support.

outcome_effects.note: The central value is the pooled tutoring RCT effect. The conservative value corresponds to 1-2 days/week and the optimistic value to during-school tutoring in the published subgroup analysis. This outcome is kept separate from the five vectors.

structured_tutoring.method_explanation: The vector layer closes part of the gap to the 70th percentile of TEACHSUP as an instructional-support proxy. Separately, it reports an evidence-based learning-outcome effect size. The two quantities are not treated as the same thing.
assumptions: Tutoring is structured, curriculum-aligned, and delivered one-to-one or in a small group.
Quality and dosage represent how fully the programme matches the stated design.
The human-support movement is a transparent proxy because PISA TEACHSUP measures school-teacher support, not private tutoring.
warnings: Do not present the human-support shift as a causal estimate from tutoring trials.
The learning effect is an average across diverse programmes and contexts, not an individual treatment effect.
structured_tutoring.time_note: Time is modelled with G(t)=1-2^(-t/4), so 4 months is the transparent half-time for implementation/adoption of the modelled endpoint. This is a scenario parameter, not a claim that individual development follows a universal law.

generic_hagwon_access.label: Generic hagwon access
generic_hagwon_access.direct_vector_claim: None until subject, weekly hours, group size, tutor quality, curriculum alignment, cost, and time burden are defined.
generic_hagwon_access.disabled_reason: Hagwon access is not one intervention. Korean causal studies find at most modest average achievement gains and cannot justify one universal vector movement. Use structured_tutoring or define a precise programme first.
generic_hagwon_access.time_note: Time is modelled with G(t)=1-2^(-t/6), so 6 months is the transparent half-time for implementation/adoption of the modelled endpoint. This is a scenario parameter, not a claim that individual development follows a universal law.

guided_digital_learning.label: Guided digital-learning integration
guided_digital_learning.evidence_level: High for changing the measured use condition when the programme is actually delivered; no automatic achievement claim
guided_digital_learning.direct_vector_claim: Improves the ICTENQ component by providing guided, enquiry-based digital learning opportunities.
guided_digital_learning.method_explanation: The programme closes a quality-, dosage-, and time-adjusted share of the gap to the 70th percentile of Korea’s observed ICTENQ distribution. This represents programme delivery, not a causal achievement effect.
assumptions: Teachers receive usable lesson materials and implementation support.
Students have enough device and connectivity access to participate.
The programme changes meaningful digital use rather than merely screen time.
warnings: The target is a transparent programme benchmark, not an experimentally estimated treatment effect.
guided_digital_learning.time_note: Time is modelled with G(t)=1-2^(-t/6), so 6 months is the transparent half-time for implementation/adoption of the modelled endpoint. This is a scenario parameter, not a claim that individual development follows a universal law.

digital_inclusion_package.label: Digital inclusion package
digital_inclusion_package.rationale: Combines home access, school infrastructure, and meaningful learning use instead of assuming a device alone changes learning.
assumptions: All three components are funded and coordinated.
Components are applied sequentially to remaining indicator gaps.
warnings: Component outcome effects are not added into a single causal achievement estimate.

targeted_learning_support_package.label: Targeted learning-support package
targeted_learning_support_package.rationale: Combines school resources, adult instructional support, and belonging rather than treating academic support as a single input.
assumptions: The student can participate consistently.
School and tutoring components are coordinated.
warnings: This is a scenario package. Evidence comes from different sources and contexts and is not one evaluated treatment.

time_method: For intervention a, realised fraction at month t is G_a(t)=1-2^(-t/h_a), where h_a is the intervention-specific implementation/adoption half-time. Overall implemented strength is quality × dosage × G_a(t). The curve is monotonic and asymptotic, so 1, 6, 12, and 24 months are distinct for a responsive profile unless the target is missing, already met, or capped.
